note: Run against a server started with DECK_PRINTINGS_ENABLED=true. READ-ONLY: the strip is drawn from the arrival URL an import writes (`?imported=1&printings=K-U`), so no row imports anything. DP_DECK is a deck the signed-in account owns with no unresolved rows (an unresolved row replaces the strip with the banner); on local-dev the probe account's `Card mark probe fixture` (d0000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000cafe) serves, and its Talisman of Progress pick (seeded for `deck-printings.json`) is what the export's body line names. The strip rows are the four states the plan's inventory lists: printing clause, not-owned clause, both, neither.

rows.label: /decks/[id]?imported=1: an import that named no printings reads as main
/decks/[id]: the export dialog names each line's printing, commanders included
